patch.value: GH-1787: extension workspace discovery ignores GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES and binds a non-Git tracker to its parent checkout

Published 2026.11.24 and 2026.11.25 supply the enclosing Git checkout as an extension command's workspace even when the explicitly selected child workspace is not in a repository by Git's own discovery. With a Git repository at parent/, a non-Git workspace at parent/child/, GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES set to parent/ and PM_SOURCE_WORKSPACE_ROOT set to child/, git rev-parse --show-toplevel refuses to discover a repository, yet a local extension command sees source_workspace_root = parent, repo_root = parent and pm_root_rel = child/.agents/pm, with or without Git on the command PATH. Expected: source_workspace_root = child, no repo_root, and pm_root_rel = .agents/pm. The pm-swarm capacity and continuation tests select Git versus tracker-only behavior from this context, and four tracker-only cases fail under an ordinary nested Git parent.

A nested non-Git tracker fixture under a real parent checkout, with the explicit source root and ceiling, gives the child root, no VCS root and the correct tracker-relative path, with and without Git on the command PATH; Ordinary Git checkouts and .git-file worktrees keep their discovery, and linked-test runs keep their independent tracker path; The linked pm-swarm tracker-only cases pass against the corrected host
An extension handler for a nested non-Git tracker under a ceiling sees the child source root, no VCS root, and the tracker path relative to the child
The handler sees the parent checkout as source and repo root and a tracker path relative to the parent
